audience: Faktuo users who create invoices, proformas, quotes and credit notes as PDF files

useCases.title: Make an invoice PDF from the job details
useCases.text: Send the supplier, the customer, the items and the VAT rate. The assistant gets the invoice back as a PDF file. Faktuo keeps no record, so send your own invoice number.

useCases.title: Issue a proforma or a quote as a PDF
useCases.text: Ask for a proforma, a tax document for an advance payment, or a quote. Send your own document number, because Faktuo numbers nothing for you.

useCases.title: Cancel an invoice with a credit note
useCases.text: Send the number of the original invoice and the amounts to refund. The PDF labels the total as to be refunded. Faktuo links the credit note to no invoice in the account.

useCases.title: Make one invoice PDF for each client on a list
useCases.text: Give the assistant a list of clients and their items, with a document number for each. It makes one invoice PDF per client.
